{{Top}}
The '''Stokhli''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of nomads from the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Manress/Legends|Manress]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'' (Unique Technical Applications)</ref> They were the inventors of the [[Spray stick/Legends|Stokhli spray stick]], a nonlethal capture device often employed by [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]].
